description: This pie chart, from the paper “Fair-PP A Synthetic Dataset for Aligning LLM with Personalized Preferences of Social Equity,” visually represents the distribution of data across six distinct categories, labeled 0 through 5, with each slice showing its percentage and absolute count. The largest segment, colored light blue, corresponds to category 2 and accounts for 22.4% (6583). The second largest, also light blue, is category 0 at 13.3% (3910). Category 1, in a pale yellow, is 13.8% (4046). Category 5, a slightly darker blue, is 10.4% (3043). Category 4, a very light blue, is 6.2% (1810). The smallest segment, category 3, is light green at 6.8% (2002). Each slice is clearly labeled with its percentage and count, and the categories are arranged in a clockwise order starting from the top, with category 2 being the largest and category 3 the smallest. There is no legend or exploded slices, and the chart is presented without any additional annotations or emphasis beyond the numerical labels.
